Method of Attack: Trojanized cryptocurrency applications used to gain access to targets' computers, spread malware, and steal private keys to initiate fraudulent blockchain transactions and steal crypto assets
Attack Vector: Spearphishing messages sent to employees (system administration, software development/DevOps) on various communication platforms
Websites advertising fake crypto apps used to push trojanized TraderTraitor applications
Indicators of Compromise: Malicious apps: DAFOM, TokenAIS, CryptAIS, AlticGO, Esilet, CreAI Deck
